steps.step4: Set goals with your case manager
steps.step7: Find a safe place to stay (call 211 or local housing resources)
steps.step8: Find food for this week (call 211 or a local food pantry)
steps.step9: Check your release papers and deadlines
steps.step10: Confirm your first check-in date and conditions
steps.step13: Get a phone, email and free internet access
steps.step14: Put every court date and check-in on a calendar
steps.step17: Check your fines, fees and restitution
steps.step19: Enroll in Medicaid, and SNAP if you need it
steps.step29: Open a bank account and make a budget
steps.step31: Reconnect with family, and handle child support if it applies
steps.step33: Set one long-term goal and celebrate your 90-day milestone

phase3.resumeHelp: Build a plain-text resume from your experience.
phase3.headline: Headline
phase3.interviewHelp: Practice answers. Your coach gives a score and one tip.
phase3.gigsHelp: Short local jobs. Check parole conditions with your officer. Phone numbers are never shown.
phase3.paidNote: Paid plan. No price has been set yet.
phase3.mentorshipHelp: Find a mentor or offer to mentor.
phase3.geoHelp: Only your city is ever shown to others. Precise location is never shared.
phase3.rideHelp: Ask for a ride. Phone numbers are never shown. Meet in a public place.
phase3.partnersHelp: Small groups of three who check in with each other.
phase3.caption: Caption
phase3.qaHelp: Ask anonymously. Answers come from members further along.
phase3.merchHelp: Coded marks only. Nothing on the outside says what they mean, and no dates are printed.
phase3.shareHelp: One card with your progress counts.
phase3.archiveHelp: Seal a note to yourself. It opens at a milestone day.
phase3.matchHelp: Your agent talks to other agents first. Dating is off for now. You can see why, override a no, and rematch.
phase3.datingOff: Dating is off until a minimum-days rule is set.
phase3.carpoolHelp: The first place to look. Opt-in, city-level only: see who is heading to your meeting and connect through in-app messages. No phone numbers, no precise location.
phase3.groupsHelp: Recovery groups, reentry support groups, and faith and community groups by city and meeting time. Sample data only — not real listings.
phase3.rideFallbackHelp: Only shown when nobody on the carpool board is heading to your meeting. Posts a moderated in-app request — city-level only, no phone numbers.
phase3.noCarpoolMatch: No carpool match for this meeting, so Needs a Ride is shown as a backup.
phase3.familyRideHelp: Approved drivers only. Pings go one at a time with a 2-minute timeout; you confirm before the next contact is pinged.
phase3.housingHelp: Savings goals plus a housing-readiness plan. Groundwork does not provide housing and does not partner with providers. For local help, call 211.
phase3.musicHelp: Sample tracks only. No streaming accounts. The player turns off inside academy and course modules.
phase3.musicOffAcademy: Music is off while you are in a course module.
phase3.shareWho: Right now: only you. Minting a link lets anyone with the link read it.
phase3.suggestHelp: Suggestions only — nothing is published until you add it.
